notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680952/4d6c8090facfbf4c0096246199094e55d9e0a68d.png

Version 1.0.2 is already released!
-Lot of optimizations has been done, on some PC's you might see up to 20-50% performance increase.
-New animations (Bobby and Darius).
-Improved lighting and visual quality in some scenes.
-Fixed lot of bugs.
-Lot of small details like face scanner in elevator or new texture for Bobby model.
-New teleport animations and improvements

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680952/f731b4d613845835082ed99d1b3c7426c15eecf2.jpg

101 everyone! First hot-fix update is here (you know how it happens after the release)

Version 1.0.1
- Fixed teleport in the beginning.
- Increased teleport sensitivity.
- Fixed some sound bugs.
- Couple of minor changes.

Enjoy the experience! If you will find more bugs - you can write to us via steam or discord. ːsteamhappyː
